name: Kaneda Maiko
source: One of the four girls living in the dorm with Takurou. She is very smart and a member of the school Science Club, but her demeanour is cold and unaproachable.
translation: One of the four girls living in the dorm with Takurou. She is very smart and a member of the school Science Club, but her demeanour is cold and unaproachable.
